title: Positive Effects of Negative Publicity: When Negative Reviews Increase Sales
citation: Berger, J., Sorensen, A. T., and Rasmussen, S. J. (2010). Marketing Science, 29(5), 815–827. doi:10.1287/mksc.1090.0557
license: Published article rights retained. The following are short attributed paraphrases, not quotations.

passages.text: Negative publicity can reduce evaluation while increasing awareness; its net effect depends on prior awareness.
For unfamiliar products, an awareness gain can offset an unfavorable evaluation. A negative sign on sales is not unconditional.
The empirical setting includes book reviews and sales. Applying the argument to film audiences requires an additional inference.
